title: Unreal Ice Pineapple Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Unreal Ice Nic Salt Pineapple Ice delivers the tropical tang and vibrant sweetness of ripe pineapple paired with a cool and refreshing icy twist. This flavour offers a perfectly balanced combination of juicy, rich pineapple and a brisk menthol finish, making it an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy tropical fruit flavours with a fresh, frosty kick. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Unreal Ice Nic Salts are perfect for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The carefully balanced formulation ensures comfortable throat hits and rich, full-bodied flavour with every puff. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, these Nicotine Salts provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings and a smoother experience compared to traditional high-strength freebase e-liquids. The Unreal Ice range from Dispergo E-Liquids brings you a collection of intensely satisfying flavours, given a fresh and frosty exhale with just the right amount of menthol added to the base. Whether you prefer fruity, menthol, or confectionary-inspired e-liquids, the Unreal Ice collection delivers exceptional flavour and unbeatable refreshment for a consistently enjoyable vape.
